import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendRealmAccess } from '@src/api/bot/realm-access-queries';
import { getBackendWorldMilestoneView } from '@src/api/bot/world-milestone-queries';
import { claimBackendWorldMilestones } from '@src/api/bot/world-milestone-actions';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 世界里程碑指令
 * 查看全服充值人数里程碑和领取奖励
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const isClaimRequest = e.MessageText.trim().includes('领取');
    const canUseMeridian = (await getBackendRealmAccess(bid)).canUseMeridian;

    if (!canUseMeridian) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('需达到筑基初期后才可访问里程碑');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const result = isClaimRequest
      ? { code: 'CLAIM_SUCCESS' as const, ...(await claimBackendWorldMilestones(bid, uid, createBackendRequestContext(e))) }
      : await getBackendWorldMilestoneView(bid, uid, createBackendRequestContext(e));

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'EMPTY': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText('暂无里程碑配置，请联系运营。');

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
      case 'CLAIM_SUCCESS': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(`成功领取 ${result.count} 个里程碑奖励！`);

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
      case 'VIEW': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addBold('🌍 全服充值进度');

        md.addButton('充值', { data: '/充值' });

        md.addNewline();
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`当前充值人数：${result.worldCountText} `));

        if (result.nextMilestoneCount !== null) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`下一档：${result.nextMilestoneCount} 人，还差 ${result.nextMilestoneGapText} 人`));
        } else {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('当前已解锁全部里程碑奖励'));
        }

        if (result.unclaimedCount > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`待领取奖励：${result.unclaimedCount} 档`));
        }

        md.addNewline();
        md.addBold('🎁 里程碑奖励');

        md.addButton('领取', { data: '/里程碑 领取' });

        md.addNewline();

        for (const milestone of result.milestones) {
          md.addBlockquote(
            Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${milestone.milestoneCount} 人里程碑 ${milestone.status}`).addNewline().addText(`${milestone.rewardText}`)
          );
        }

        void message.send(
          FormatGui({
            isPrivate,
            bid,
            title: '世界充值里程碑',
            content: md
          })
        );
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('里程碑处理失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, '里程碑奖励', '操作失败，请稍后再试。', createBackendRequestContext(e));

    md.addText(failMsg);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
